package.name: cell_planning_service
package.description: The cell's planning service: one ROS 2 service interface (plan to pose, plan to joints, plan a Cartesian segment, check a trajectory, add/remove/sync collision objects) with switchable backends. Returns time-parameterized trajectories and never executes. This package holds the backend contract, the generic service adapter, and the MoveIt plan-only backend. Registry-free: callers supply every parameter.
